result.description:
Position: Civil Engineer 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: KFM Geotech Pty Ltd 
Location: Castle Hill NSW 2154 
Salary: $80,080 p/a
About the Business: 
KFM Geotech Pty Ltd is a reputable geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater engineering consulting firm based in Castle Hill, NSW. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Hossein Bazyar, we deliver comprehensive site investigations, construction phase support, pavement design, foundation engineering, contamination assessments, and hydrogeological services to builders, developers, architects, engineers, and government clients across New South Wales. Committed to excellence, innovation, integrity, and sustainability, we prioritise high-quality, timely, and budget-conscious solutions that ensure safe, compliant, and successful development projects while fostering a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
About the Position: 
The Civil Engineer plays a pivotal role in delivering expert geotechnical and civil engineering solutions that underpin safe and efficient construction projects at KFM Geotech Pty Ltd. This position involves conducting site investigations, providing construction-phase support, designing foundations and pavements, assessing environmental and groundwater conditions, and ensuring all deliverables meet regulatory standards and client requirements in a dynamic consulting environment.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Conduct geotechnical site investigations, soil/rock testing, and analysis to inform foundation, retaining wall, and pavement designs.
•	Provide construction-phase geotechnical support, including excavation monitoring, bearing capacity assessments, and on-site inspections.
•	Prepare detailed technical reports, drawings, and recommendations for clients, councils, and stakeholders.
•	Perform environmental and groundwater assessments, including contamination and hydrogeological evaluations.
•	Collaborate with project teams, clients, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with Australian standards and project timelines.
•	Contribute to project management, risk assessments, and continuous improvement of geotechnical practices.
Requirements:
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Minimum Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent).
•	Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a civil engineer, preferably in geotechnical consulting or construction.
•	Strong technical skills in geotechnical analysis, foundation design, site investigation, and report writing.
•	Proficiency with relevant software (e.g., geotechnical modelling tools) and excellent problem-solving abilities.
•	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities under pressure.
How to Apply: 
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Construction Project Manager – Sydney CBD 

Kogan People Solutions is working with a leading provider of advisory, project and asset management services across the entire infrastructure spectrum. This respected entity offers integrated solutions across social, commercial, transport, utilities and defence infrastructure. Their teams have worked with many of Australia’s most influential brands and institutions from the government/ private and not-for-profit sectors, delivering city shaping and nation-building infrastructure. 

They now seek a Construction Project Manager to manage a multitude of projects and will enjoy a reporting line to members of the senior project team. The role is full time, and ongoing. 

The entity is the result of a recent merger of two successful significant respected entities; collectively they enjoy relationships with many clients who hold them in the highest regard. 

This is a great place to work…. join them! 

This vital position will provide the delivery of high-quality project management services: 

•	Sydney inner city location 

•	Salary negotiable in the range $100k to $110k plus superannuation per annum 

•	Excellent dynamics, friendly and supportive close team culture 

•	Excellent long term career path and team culture 

•	Much client contact and engagement (including bids, tenders, and proposals) 


 Location (work base) 

Sydney CBD  


 Responsibilities  

•	Project management of existing and new construction projects. 

•	Coordinating tenders for new construction projects. 

•	Developing relationships with both existing and new clients. 

•	Co-ordinating sub-contractors to ensure projects are completed in a timely manner. 

•	Liaising with client’s architects and other interested parties. 

•	Overseeing construction projects to ensure high standard of work is maintained. 

•	Coordinating labour and materials. 

•	Managing / overseeing budget / costs programme. 

•	Interpreting drawings and specifications. 

•	Communicating broadly and effectively across the firm and ensure all internal parties are kept informed of key developments in projects including potential issues requiring escalation. 

•	Presenting as a positive brand ambassador for the firm.   

Required experience, skills and qualifications required to be considered for this opportunity:  

 •	You will ideally demonstrate previous Project Management experience (at least 1 years post qualified, preferably much more) within a similar commercial development and construction environment. 

•	You will be competent with reading and understanding detailed construction plans, documents, and agreements in accordance with construction codes and standards. 

•	You will have strong industry knowledge in construction. 

•	We would expect at least a bachelor’s degree in a highly relevant subject area, or agreed alternative. 

•	Excellent client skills and empathy. 

•	Well-developed communication skills. 

•	Commitment to improving your professional knowledge. 

You must have unrestricted Australian working rights to be considered for this role.

Applications: Please send your details and covering letter to our recruiters Kogan People Solutions, quoting reference number 6182, using the contact details on this site. 

Please note we will only be able to notify shortlisted applicants.
